notes.price_c_lb: IHCAFE average price per 46-kg bag exported, crop to date
notes.prem_ctd: crop-to-date export price minus the KC front average since 1 Oct
notes.marg_c_lb: exports registered over the last ~2 weeks, priced from the change in export value
notes.marg_prem: that price minus the KC front average over the same days (contracts are fixed earlier, so a proxy)
notes.band_shg_c_lb: contracted SHG/HG sales, US$ price-band midpoints, crop to date

notes.net_prem: FNC internal price per carga in US$ (TRM) and c/lb green, minus KC front: premium net of internal costs
notes.fob_prem: the same scaled by the ratio implied by FNC's latest published monthly differential: FOB-equivalent premium
notes.history: weekly (Friday) points, last 12 years; daily from 2003 in the CSV

notes.fob: FOB differential to the ICE contract named in the report (KC for arabica, London for conilon where stated), c/lb, mid of range
notes.domestic: spot R$ per 60-kg bag at origin (SAFRAS), converted at BCB PTAX; basis = that price in c/lb minus KC 2nd/3rd-position average
notes.monthly: monthly average of the quotes in that month

vietnam.exports_note: NSO monthly socio-economic report, export annex: coffee, thousand tonnes (all types, green and processed as NSO counts them) and average value in US$ per tonne.
